newsitem.title: USA: U.S. farm trade surplus $2.068 billion in February.
newsitem.headline: U.S. farm trade surplus $2.068 billion in February.

text.p: The U.S. trade surplus in agricultural commodities was $2.060 billion in February, down from $2.139 billion in January, the Commerce Department said Thursday.
In its monthly trade report, Commerce pegged farm exports at $4.830 billion in February, down from $4.901 billion in January. Imports in both months were $2.762 billion.

Corn exports fell by $100 million to $526 million in February. Cotton exports were up slightly, to $281 million. Rice, at $100 million, and soybeans, at $831 million, were up slightly. Fruits, vegetables, hides and skins were down.
Imports of most goods were stable. Fruits and vegetables fell by $41 million to total $706 million. Coffee surged to $274 million, up $54 million.
